title: LanguageDeclaration
description: Internal static configuration parsed from a native language declaration. Python I/O endpoints are declared by decorators in explicitly listed modules.

examples.description: JSON file, relative to the package, listing {request, program} pairs (optionally with a simulation environment) used to show the language in use to an LLM.

program.description: The procedure is a Hypomnesis value of type 'a Effect.t, interpreted by the engine. The language declares the sensors and actuators it may use.

entry.description: Binding of the M1 program holding the procedure.
